sources.name: City of Asylum · Alphabet City
sources.scope: Thursday Night Jazz on the current concert page, within 45 days. Reserve the free livestream ticket, rather than an in-person seat.

sources.name: Herbie Hancock Institute of Jazz
sources.scope: October 10–11, 2026 competition broadcasts. These dated listings expire unless their evidence is reviewed again within 14 days.
sources.assessment: The official announcement confirms worldwide free online viewing of the semifinals and the finals with the All-Star Gala Concert.

sources.name: CU Boulder College of Music
sources.scope: Selected jazz concerts with event-specific streaming announcements. The October 30 listing covers Grusin Music Hall only. Evidence requires review within 14 days.
sources.assessment: The College of Music offers free livestreams. The selected official event pages supply dates and explicitly identify live streaming.

sources.name: University of Kansas · Lied Center
sources.scope: The October 8, 2026 Jazz Ensembles concert. The event is individually reviewed; other concerts are not assumed to stream.
sources.assessment: The official dated event offers a free livestream separately from paid seats in the auditorium.

sources.name: Monks Jazz Club
sources.assessment: Regular livestreams cost $10 per show or require the $40 Patreon tier. Public Wednesday jams may qualify individually, but no current dated free jam was verified.
